title: WordPress Blocks Six Backdoored WP Connect Plugins Before Malicious Releases Go Live
summary: WordPress has removed six WordPress plugins developed by WP Connect after they were backdoored on November 22, 2026, to enable arbitrary code execution on sites that have them installed, following a suspected compromise of the developer's account.
